tools.name: hawkeye_search
tools.description: Search the user's Hawkeye-indexed files and return matching files with code snippets. Prefer hawkeye_search_minimal plus hawkeye_expand_context for most lookups; use this when you want the full match text in one call.

tools.name: hawkeye_search_minimal
tools.description: Find where something is in the user's Hawkeye-indexed files: code, config, assets or text, in any language or project type (not only Unity/Unreal). Use this instead of grep, Glob or Read for lookups like 'where is X defined', 'who uses Y', 'find the Z handler'. Returns grouped results: each file once with a lines array (token-efficient); pass them to hawkeye_expand_context for the surrounding code. Use hawkeye_get_groups for mask IDs. Try this first even if unsure the files are indexed - an empty result is cheap.

groupMasks.description: Group mask IDs (e.g. "12"), not display names

maxResults.description: Max line hits to return (default 50 from settings)

tools.name: hawkeye_expand_context
tools.description: Expand search hits into merged code snippets read from disk. Pass the {file, lines} pairs from hawkeye_search_minimal (or a filtered subset). Nearby hits in the same file are merged into one snippet (default merge gap 8 lines, -2/+5 context). Returns one snippet per cluster per file in a single call - use this instead of reading each hit individually.

hits.description: Array of {file, lines} objects, e.g. the "results" array returned by hawkeye_search_minimal

contextBefore.description: Lines of context before each cluster's first hit (default 2)

contextAfter.description: Lines of context after each cluster's last hit (default 5)

mergeGap.description: Merge hits within this many lines of each other into one snippet (default 8)

maxTotalLines.description: Cap on total lines returned across the whole response (default 1000). If exceeded, sets truncated:true and lists cut clusters in truncated_clusters.

tools.name: hawkeye_get_groups
tools.description: Get available search groups from Hawkeye

tools.name: hawkeye_get_editors
tools.description: Get available editors configured in Hawkeye

tools.name: hawkeye_execute_editor
tools.description: Execute a file in a specified editor with line number support

tools.name: hawkeye_health_check
tools.description: Check if Hawkeye is running and accessible

tools.name: hawkeye_reload_index
tools.description: Trigger a headless Hawkeye index reload (no window, doesn't steal focus). Only call this when the user asks to reload, refresh or rescan the index. Do not call it on your own after a search returns zero or unexpected results - treat that as a normal empty result. Not scoped to a group - reloads the whole index. Returns quickly; the reload itself runs in the background.

tools.name: validate_hawkeye_path
tools.description: Validate if the configured Hawkeye installation path exists on disk
